giver: The Couriers: cartographers in every village hand out runs; Postmistress Juniper Quill runs the Couriers' post office in Reece and gives the key runs
feel: Deliveries against the clock: first on foot between villages and over rooftops, then by hook and zipline, then by sea in ever bigger ships, and finally by air. Every run has a parcel, a recipient and a deadline.

quests.title: Sign the Roster
quests.summary: A cartographer pins a Couriers' notice to the board: runners wanted. Sign on at the Reece post office and carry your first signed letter to the nearest village's cartographer.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a courier's satchel (bundle) and a stack of letters

quests.title: Beat the Bell
quests.summary: Juniper's runner has twisted an ankle and the morning post must reach the next village before the noon bell. Make the run on the clock; arrive in time and the runner gives you their shoes for good.

quests.title: Over, Not Around
quests.summary: Couriers don't take the street. Learn ParCool's vault, roll and wall-run on a marked rooftop line across Reece and finish it under the time on the chalk board.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a ParCool guide and traceur gloves

quests.title: Don't Unpack It
quests.summary: A family is moving house and their strongbox can't be emptied on the way. Pick up the whole chest with Carry On and walk it to the new cottage, then carry their sleeping cat over too.

quests.title: Under a Grey Sky
quests.summary: A courier stranded by a thunderstorm on a cliff path (encounter) begs you to finish their run: take the parcel down the wet cliff route to the cove below without falling. Their umbrella is the thanks.

quests.title: Stamps and Tape
quests.summary: Juniper wants a real post office: craft Ender Mail packing tape, stamps and a package controller, set up a locker at the Reece post office and send your first stamped package to another village's locker.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a stack of stamps

quests.title: Marking the Route
quests.summary: Old couriers left waystones along the roads. Find and attune three wild waystones between Reece and the neighbouring villages so later runs can start halfway.

quests.title: Before the Light Goes
quests.summary: A parcel of medicine must cross a great ravine bridge to a village on the far side before dusk. Find the old stone bridge and make the crossing on the clock.

quests.title: The Long Drop Line
quests.summary: A large village's couriers race a rooftop route with drops that would break legs. Run the whole line, gaps and drops included, under the record; the record holder hands over their bouncy boots.

quests.title: The Night Post
quests.summary: An urgent letter must go out after dark across open country. Monsters ambush the road (encounter): take the hits and keep running, because stopping to fight loses the deadline. Juniper gives you the necklace she wore on her own night runs.

quests.title: Line from the Tower
quests.summary: The Couriers' lookout is an old cartographer tower. Climb it, and rig a ParCool zipline from its top to the road below so runners can drop letters down in seconds.

quests.title: Hook and Swing
quests.summary: Craft a grappling hook and swing across a canyon course the Couriers marked with flags, faster than the long way round on foot.

quests.title: Stuck on the Ledge
quests.summary: A young courier who took a shortcut is stuck on a cliff ledge with a broken leg (encounter). Grapple down, pick them up with Carry On and bring them and their satchel safely back to the village.
quests.reward: Agility XP, healing potions and the courier's sealed letters to finish

quests.title: Across the Bay
quests.summary: A beach village's post piles up across the water. Build a Small Ships rowboat, then a cog, and ferry three crates of mail over the bay.

quests.title: No Boats Allowed
quests.summary: A bet in the beach village: cross the lake to the far pier without a boat and before the hourglass runs out. Sprint, swim and leap; the bet's winner keeps the strange shoes that run on water.

quests.title: Powder Road
quests.summary: An alpine village is snowed in and waiting for winter supplies. Carry the parcel over the powder snow fields to the mountain outpost before the storm closes the pass; the outpost's courier gives you their snowshoes.

quests.title: Speed Climb
quests.summary: Upgrade your hook with a motor and get wall-run boots, then race up the peak below a monastery against a rival courier's time.

quests.title: The Lighthouse Run
quests.summary: The lighthouse keeper's oil comes by sea. Build a brigg with cargo room and take a full load of lamp oil and letters up the coast to the lighthouse.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a spyglass and a cannon

quests.title: Mail for the Fleet
quests.summary: An outcast fisherman lives on his little boat far out at sea, and his family ashore hasn't heard from him in months. Sail out, find a boat at sea and hand him their letters; he has a reply to send back.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a sea chart (explorer map) and the fisherman's reply

quests.title: Bamboo Wings
quests.summary: A firewatch tower deep in the woods needs post nobody can walk to in a day. Build an Immersive Aircraft bamboo hopper and fly the first airmail to its keeper.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a propeller and fuel

quests.title: The Float That Got Away
quests.summary: A child's pool float slipped its string and drifted up to an island floating in the sky (encounter with the crying child). Get up there by hook, plane or pillar and bring it back; the child lets you keep it.

quests.title: Bottle a Cloud
quests.summary: The sky villagers say the best clouds gather above their highest roof. Climb the sky village to its very top and bottle one, the old way.
quests.reward: Agility XP, Cloud in a Bottle

quests.title: Post Office in the Clouds
quests.summary: The sky village has never had a post office. Set up an Ender Mail locker there, then carry the first ground-mail up and the first sky-mail down.

quests.title: Oars Against the Wind
quests.summary: A rival harbour's couriers say their drakkar is faster than anything the Couriers sail. Build your own drakkar and beat them along the coast course, buoy to buoy.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a stack of sails and the rivals' banner

quests.title: Convoy to the Sea Town
quests.summary: A merchant convoy must reach a beach village across the gulf through waters a pillager ship and a pirate wreck patrol. Captain a galley and keep the cargo cog afloat all the way.
quests.reward: Agility XP, cannonballs and the merchant's trade goods

quests.title: Three Villages, One Day
quests.summary: Build a biplane and run the airmail: three villages, three parcels, one day from sunrise to sunset.

quests.title: Feathers Not Engines
quests.summary: Juniper's grandfather flew the post on homemade wings. Craft a pair of Icarus feathered wings and glide from the sky village back down to Reece without touching the ground.
quests.reward: Agility XP, Icarus wings in the Couriers' colours

quests.title: The Lost Couriers' Log
quests.summary: A courier crew vanished chasing a great airship through the clouds. Reach one of the airships and bring back their logbook from among the dangers aboard.
quests.reward: Agility XP, the log's route map and a gyroscope

quests.title: Freight by Air
quests.summary: The far villages want bulk goods, not letters. Build a cargo airship and fly a full hold of building supplies to a village beyond the mountains.

quests.title: Every Village a Stop
quests.summary: Make the Couriers' network permanent: craft sharestones and warp plates and place one in every village the Couriers serve, all linked to the Reece post office.

quests.title: Elytra on the Route
quests.summary: Elytra from the End change everything: wear them in the Elytra Slot alongside your chestplate and fly the full courier circuit of five villages without landing.

quests.title: The Grand Relay
quests.summary: The Couriers' great race: one parcel around the whole network in a single day, on foot over rooftops, by ship across the bay and by air to the sky village, against the best runners from every village.

quests.title: Seven Leagues
quests.summary: Juniper hands you the post office keys and the Couriers' oldest treasure, reforged for you.
quests.reward: Agility XP, Juniper's Seven-League Boots (named netherite boots: Feather Falling IV, Depth Strider III, Soul Speed III, Unbreaking III, Mending)
